item.text:
Mistral’s documentation says the `document_url` input is supported with **all chat models** through the built-in Document QnA/OCR feature—not just vision models. The document is OCR-processed and its extracted content is supplied to the selected LLM. ([Document QnA](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/document-processing/document_qna), [Mistral OCR cookbook](https://docs.mistral.ai/resources/cookbooks/mistral-ocr-document_understanding))

Pass the document as another content part in the user message:

```python
from mistralai.client import Mistral

client = Mistral(api_key="...")

response = client.chat.complete(
    model="mistral-small-latest",  # or another supported chat model
    messages=[{
        "role": "user",
        "content": [
            {"type": "text", "text": "Summarize this document."},
            {
                "type": "document_url",
                "document_url": "https://example.com/document.pdf"
            }
        ]
    }]
)
```

The URL must be publicly accessible to Mistral’s API. For a local PDF, upload it first, obtain a signed URL, and pass that signed URL as `document_url`. The docs also show base64-encoded PDF and uploaded-PDF variants. ([Document QnA usage](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/document-processing/document_qna))

For images rather than PDF/documents, use the vision-capable models and an `image_url` content part instead. ([Vision documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/conversations/vision))
